title.value: Towards an AAK Theory Approach to Approximate Minimization in the Multi-Letter Case
title.justification: The title reflects the paper's focus on using AAK theory for approximate minimization applied to weighted finite automata with multi-letter alphabets.
title.quote: Towards an AAK Theory Approach to Approximate Minimization in the Multi-Letter Case

extractions.description: The paper discusses the approximate minimization problem of weighted finite automata (WFAs) and proposes a framework using Adamyan-Arov-Krein (AAK) theory for its approximation, specifically extending the application from one-letter to multi-letter alphabets.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper is focused on theoretical aspects of computational optimization in automata theory and does not directly relate to climate or ecological themes.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: We study the approximate minimization problem of weighted finite automata (WFAs): given a WFA, we want to compute its optimal approximation when restricted to a given size.

primary_category.justification: There is no direct reference or applicability to climate or ecologically-related sustainable development in the paper.
primary_category.quote: This approach has already been successfully applied to the case of WFAs and language modelling black boxes over one-letter alphabets (Balle et al., 2021; Lacroce et al., 2021).
